description: Redaction in calls (`redact-call.road`). Client r2 calls strict Issuer r1's `issue` with a sensitive `pin`: it is redacted in r2's `started` and `invoke.started` and in r1's `call` input, and the sensitive `secret` of the `Token` r1 replies with is redacted in r1's `replied`, r2's `invoke.done` input and its `set`. After `Close`, r1 has no `on issue`, so Client r3's call ends r1 with an `unhandled` defect, whose call input has `pin` redacted as an `event` record's would; r3 takes `fail Unanswered`.
